text: And a gentleman's hands, they insist, are clean.
action: a senior doctor holding up his stick hand with a sparkle effect

text: The idea that they themselves have been
action: doctors with offended faces, steam lines from their ears

text: spreading death is not just wrong, it's insulting.
action: a doctor slamming a book shut

text: Some of them say your theory is nonsense. Others say it's unscientific,
action: a doctor pointing at {YOU} with a speech bubble reading NONSENSE

text: since you can't explain exactly what these invisible particles are.
action: an inset of a magnifying glass over an empty hand, a question mark

text: You can't even see them. You just have numbers.
action: {YOU} holding up a ledger, the doctors ignoring it

text: And your personality isn't helping.
action: {YOU} pointing furiously at the doctors

text: You're still the loud fifth child from the grocery shop.
action: an inset of {YOU6} shouting on a chair, from his childhood

text: You don't persuade people. You correct them.
action: {YOU} wagging a finger at a red-faced senior doctor

text: Professor Klein is furious.
action: {KLEIN} storming into {YOU}'s office, red-faced

text: Your success makes his clinic look like a slaughterhouse,
action: an inset of a butcher's shop sign over the First Clinic door

text: and makes him look like the butcher.
action: {KLEIN}'s face reflected as a butcher in a mirror, horrified

text: In 1849, when your contract comes up for renewal,
action: {KLEIN} holding a contract labelled 1849

text: he simply doesn't renew it.
action: {KLEIN} tearing the contract in half

text: Just like that, you're out.
action: {YOU} carrying a box of belongings down the corridor

text: Without you there, standing by the basin, the students stop washing.
action: the basin sitting dry and dusty, students walking past it

text: They always hated it anyway. You hear the numbers start climbing again,
action: an inset of a ledger with crosses climbing again

text: and there's nothing you can do about it.
action: {YOU} staring at the ledger, helpless

text: In 1850, after a final humiliation at the university,
action: {YOU} standing alone in an empty lecture hall

text: you pack your bags and leave Vienna without saying goodbye to anyone.
action: {YOU} carrying a suitcase alone to a coach at dawn

text: Not even your few remaining friends.
action: {YOU} glancing back at the city, no one waving

text: You go home to Hungary.
action: a coach rolling over a road into Pest, the Danube beside it

text: In Pest, you take an unpaid position at a small,
action: a small, run-down hospital with peeling walls and a crooked sign reading ST. ROCHUS

text: run down hospital called St. Rochus. Its maternity ward is a disaster.
action: a crowded, dirty maternity ward with cracked windows

text: You introduce your basin. The death rate collapses again, to almost nothing.
action: {YOU} setting down a basin at the ward door, the ledger crosses vanishing

text: Later, you become a professor of obstetrics at the University of Pest.
action: {YOU} lecturing a class of students at the University of Pest

text: You marry. You have children.
action: {YOU} and {WIFE} at a modest wedding photo-style portrait, two small children beside them

text: For a few years, life is almost good.
action: {YOU} at a cozy family dinner table, {WIFE} and the children smiling

text: You teach your students to wash.
action: {YOU} watching students wash their hands at a basin

text: You walk your children along the Danube,
action: {YOU} walking with {CHILDREN} along the Danube promenade at dusk

text: the way you once walked with Kolletschka.
action: {YOU} glancing at an empty bench by the river

text: Some evenings you even forget to talk about childbed fever.
action: {YOU} relaxing in an armchair reading a book

text: Some evenings.
action: {YOU} glancing at a pile of ledgers in the corner

text: But you can't let it go.
action: {YOU} staring at the ledgers, jaw tightening

text: You know thousands of women are still
action: an inset map of Europe with red crosses blooming over hospital cities

text: dying every year in hospitals across Europe,
action: an inset of hospital wards across Europe with empty beds

text: from something that could be stopped with a bucket of bleach.
action: an inset of a simple bucket of bleach glowing with a halo

text: And nobody is listening.
action: an inset of a crowd of doctors with their fingers in their ears

text: In 1861, you finally publish your book. Five hundred pages of evidence.
action: {YOU} holding up a thick published book with 1861 on the cover

text: Tables. Charts. Years of numbers.
action: an inset of the book's pages full of tables and charts

text: The reviews are savage.
action: {YOU} reading newspaper reviews, his face falling

text: Doctors across Europe dismiss it, ignore it, or laugh at it.
action: an inset of doctors laughing and tossing the book in a bin

text: So you start writing letters.
action: {YOU} dipping a quill and writing furiously

text: Open letters, to the most famous obstetricians in Europe,
action: stacks of letters addressed to famous doctors across Europe

text: published for the public to read. You stop being polite.
action: an inset of a newspaper printing an OPEN LETTER

text: You call them ignorant. You call them irresponsible.
action: close-up of the letter with the words IGNORANT and IRRESPONSIBLE underlined

text: Then you call them murderers.
action: extreme close-up of the word MURDERERS written in bold ink

text: Your wife notices the change first.
action: {WIFE} watching {YOU} with concern across the room

text: You talk about childbed fever at dinner.
action: {YOU} lecturing at the dinner table, the children staring at their plates

text: You talk about it at parties.
action: {YOU} lecturing guests at a party, guests edging away

text: You talk about it to strangers in the street. You can't sleep.
action: {YOU} lecturing a confused stranger in the street

text: You can't stop. You start drinking. You start forgetting things.
action: {YOU47} pacing at night with a glass of wine, papers scattered

text: Your colleagues at the university begin to whisper.
action: colleagues whispering behind their hands in a corridor

text: You still have the numbers. But nobody wants to hear them anymore.
action: {YOU47} clutching his ledgers alone, candle burning low

text: In the summer of 1865, an old colleague from Vienna,
action: {COLLEAGUE} arriving at the door with a warm smile, summer sun outside

text: a respected doctor you once trusted,
action: close-up of {COLLEAGUE}'s smooth, confident smile

text: invites you to visit a new medical
action: {COLLEAGUE} handing {YOU47} an invitation card reading NEW INSTITUTE

text: institute he wants to show you. Your wife comes with you.
action: {YOU47} and {WIFE} sitting in a carriage beside {COLLEAGUE}

text: It's a long journey. You're tired. You're curious.
action: a carriage rolling down a long country road, {YOU47} dozing

text: You've just turned 47 when you walk through the gates.
action: {YOU47} stepping out at tall iron gates in front of a grim building

text: It isn't a medical institute. It's an asylum.
action: a low-angle view of a sign over the gates reading ASYLUM

text: You realize it the moment the doors close behind you.
action: heavy doors slamming shut behind {YOU47}

text: You turn around. Your colleague is already leaving.
action: {YOU47} turning to see {COLLEAGUE} walking away through the gate

text: You try to follow him. Attendants grab your arms. You fight.
action: {GUARDS} grabbing {YOU47}'s stick arms as he lunges toward the gate

text: You've always fought. You've fought Klein. You've fought Vienna.
action: close-up of {YOU47}'s furious face, insets of {KLEIN} and the senior doctors behind him

text: You've fought all of Europe.
action: an inset map of Europe with {YOU47} shaking his fist at it

text: But this time, you lose.
action: {YOU47}'s stick arms pinned by {GUARDS}, his face falling

text: The guards beat you. They kick you.
action: shadows of {GUARDS} looming over a fallen figure on a stone floor, impact lines only

text: They force you into a straitjacket and
action: {YOU47} bound in a straitjacket in a dark stone cell

text: lock you in a dark cell. Somewhere in the struggle, you're injured.
action: a heavy cell door closing, a small barred window above

text: A wound on your hand. You barely notice it at first.
action: close-up of a small bandage on the end of {YOU47}'s stick arm

text: Within days, the fever comes.
action: {YOU47} shivering in the corner of the cell, sweat drops

text: The chills. The swelling. The pain.
action: {YOU47}'s flushed face with sweat drops and chattering teeth

text: You know exactly what it is. You've seen it a thousand times.
action: {YOU47}'s eyes widening in recognition

text: On the table in the dead house.
action: a ghostly memory of the morgue with sheet-covered tables

text: In the bodies of the mothers.
action: a ghostly memory of empty beds in the First Clinic

text: In the autopsy report of your friend.
action: a ghostly memory of {KOLL}'s autopsy report

text: Nobody in that asylum washes their hands.
action: {GUARDS} walking past a dry, dusty washbasin

text: Two weeks after you arrive, on August 13th, 1865,
action: a calendar on the wall reading AUGUST 13, 1865

text: you die of an infected wound. Childbed fever in everything but name.
action: {YOU47} lying still on a cot with soft X-eyes, peaceful face, moonlight through the bars

text: The same disease you spent your life fighting.
action: an inset of the green glowing specks drifting through the cell

text: Killed by the same dirty hands.
action: an inset of a dirty pair of stick hands

text: Very few people come to your funeral.
action: a small funeral at a grave with only three mourners in the rain

text: The medical societies barely mention it.
action: a medical journal page with a tiny obituary notice in the corner

text: When your family clears out your desk, they find years of letters,
action: {WIFE} sorting through stacks of letters and ledgers at the empty desk

text: tables, and ledgers.
action: piles of ledgers and tables on the floor

text: And at the very back of a drawer, folded and yellowed,
action: {WIFE} pulling a yellowed folded paper from the back of a drawer

text: an old death certificate from the First Clinic. A laundress named Anna.
action: extreme close-up of an old death certificate reading ANNA, LAUNDRESS

text: Twenty years old. Cause of death, childbed fever.
action: close-up of the certificate text: AGE 20, CHILDBED FEVER

text: Nobody knows why you kept it. Nobody asks.
action: {WIFE} looking at the certificate with a puzzled, sad face

text: And here's the part nobody tells you.
action: a bright establishing view of a Scottish infirmary in 1867

text: Within two years of your death,
action: a calendar flipping from 1865 to 1867

text: a surgeon in Scotland named Joseph Lister begins
action: {LISTER} spraying a fine mist of carbolic over an operating table

text: cleaning his wounds and instruments with chemicals, and his patients stop dying.
action: {LISTER} cleaning surgical instruments in a basin, patients recovering in beds

text: In France, a chemist named Louis Pasteur proves that invisible living organisms,
action: {PASTEUR} peering into a microscope in a laboratory full of flasks

text: germs, cause disease. The particles you couldn't see were real.
action: an inset of microscopic germs labelled GERMS, the same green specks from earlier

text: Every number you ever wrote was right.
action: an inset of {YOU}'s old ledger with a glowing tick mark

text: Within a few decades,
action: a calendar flipping forward rapidly through the decades

text: every hospital in the world requires doctors to wash their hands.
action: modern hospital staff washing their hands at a row of steel sinks

text: Today, a university in Budapest carries your name.
action: a grand university building in Budapest with the name SEMMELWEIS UNIVERSITY over the entrance

text: Scientists even named a reflex after you. The Semmelweis reflex.
action: an inset of a textbook page titled THE SEMMELWEIS REFLEX

text: It describes the instinct to reject new evidence
action: an inset of a man covering his ears while a scientist shows him a chart

text: because it contradicts what everyone already believes.
action: an inset of a crowd shaking their heads at new evidence

text: They named the stubbornness after you. Not the doctors who were stubborn.
action: an inset of a portrait of {YOU} beside the word STUBBORN

text: You.
action: close-up of {YOU} raising one eyebrow

text: Your name is Ignaz Semmelweis.
action: a framed engraved portrait of {YOU} with a brass plaque reading IGNAZ SEMMELWEIS

text: And the next time you stand at a sink and
action: {MODERN} standing at a modern bathroom sink

text: wash your hands for twenty seconds without thinking about it,
action: close-up of soapy stick hands under a running tap, a 20-second timer

text: remember that someone once lost everything for asking you to do it.
action: {MODERN} glancing up at the mirror, a faint reflection of {YOU47} looking back

text: The numbers never lied.
action: an inset of the old ledger with the zero glowing

text: They just took the world fifty years to read them.
action: the modern sink with the old ledger resting on the counter, water still running
